'''Georges Chapouthier''' (born 27 March 1945 in [[Libourne]]) is a French [[neuroscientist]] and [[philosophy|philosopher]].

==Biography==
Georges Chapouthier is the son of Odette Mazaubert and [[:fr:Fernand Chapouthier|Fernand Chapouthier]] (1899–1953). Fernand Chapouthier was a [[Classics|classicist]] and [[archaeology|archeologist]] who was deputy director of the [[École Normale Supérieure|Ecole normale supérieure]] in Paris. Odette Mazaubert was known under the pseudonym of "Carquelin" for her [[Saintongeais]] writings.<ref>{{cite journal | title = A propos de... Odette Mazaubert Chapouthier : un parcours littéraire atypique | journal = Aguiaine | year = 2006 | first = Georges | last = Chapouthier | volume = 39 | issue = 253 | pages = 60–62| url = http://www.sefco-subiet.eu/SOMMAIRES/DROITE-sommaires-2006.htm | access-date = 2010-10-03}}</ref> Chapouthier attended the [[Lycée Montaigne (Paris)|Lycée Montaigne]] and the [[Lycée Louis-le-Grand]] in Paris. He then followed the "[[classe préparatoire aux grandes ecoles|Classes Préparatoires aux Grandes Écoles]]" at the [[Lycée Saint-Louis]] and subsequently enrolled at the Ecole normale supérieure in 1964. Chapouthier then studied biology and philosophy, obtaining a "[[Habilitation|doctorat d'état]]" in both (University of Strasbourg, 1973, and [[Jean Moulin University Lyon 3]], 1986, respectively).

During his whole career, Chapouthier has worked for the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] (CNRS), where he currently has the rank of emeritus [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|research director]]. His research focuses on the [[pharmacology]] of [[memory]] and [[anxiety]] and on [[philosophy]], especially the relations between humans and animals.<ref>{{cite news|title=Au bon vouloir de Georges Chapouthier |year=2005 |publisher=Pro-Anima |url=http://www.proanima.fr/les-lettres/les-lettres.php |work=Sciences Enjeux Santé |volume=38 |pages=11 |access-date=2010-10-03 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081112075453/http://www.proanima.fr/les-lettres/les-lettres.php |archive-date=2008-11-12 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | title = Entretien: Georges Chapouthier | journal = Synapse | language=fr |date=October 2006 | first = Arnaud | last = Plagnol | volume = 228  | pages = 8–15| url = http://blog.bebook.fr/jardinier/public/C%3A%5CDocuments%20and%20Settings%5CAdministrateur%5CMes%20documents%5CImages_Blog_html_33592776/entretien_synapse_2281.pdf | access-date = 2010-10-03}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | title = Georges Chapouthier, Neurobiologiste: Passion double | journal = Le Journal du CNRS | year = 2010 | first = Marie | last = Lescroart | volume = 240–241 | issue = Jan–Feb | pages = 17| url = http://www2.cnrs.fr/presse/journal/4649.htm | access-date = 2010-10-03}}</ref>

As a philosopher, he was influenced by [[Louis Bourgey]] and [[François Dagognet]].
